## Où j'en suis
The 12/11 replay tool is built and validated: `cmd/replay` streams the raw archive with per-partition ordering, writes rejects to S3, and only ever produces to `events.replay.v3`. The dry run on the incident window completed (18,442,107 events to replay, 3,118 schema v2 lines rejected) and PR #233 is open with Daniel as reviewer; the real replay and aggregator backfill are not run yet.

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/ingest#233 awaiting Daniel's review
- [prochaine-étape] Run the real replay into events.replay.v3, then aggregator --backfill for 2026-11-12
- [prochaine-étape] Rachel's ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly (due Friday) is given by the user after Daniel's review
- [essai-raté] First dry run at --batch 50000 was OOMKilled (4 batches in flight over the 2Gi limit); rerun at --batch 5000 succeeded in 19m42s
- [décision] Replay all lost events into events.replay.v3 only, never events.v3, no age cutoff; the aggregator reads it with --backfill (source: t05)
- [décision] Memory limit stays untouched (namespace quota capped by Noa); use --batch 5000 (source: t13)
